(—Ngh, huh? Why do my legs feel a little heavy?
Ah, could it be because I didn't get much sleep...?)

She had to be exhausted, so I wanted to tell her to take it easy today.
I started to say so, but—

Yet on the other hand, racing is inherently an individual sport.
It wasn't impossible that this ideal could one day become a shackle for her.

And they're off for the 1400m Turf Mock Race! Today's runners
to watch are Hishi Akebono and Biko Pegasus!

Ehehe... yeah!
Thank you, Trainer.
Next time, I'm definitely, definitely, DEFINITELY gonna win!
Wh-what brought this on all of a sudden~?

Huh, ginger and perilla in the fish meatballs, huh... Tastes great.
I'll have to borrow that idea!

—Afterward, many more Umamusume showed up to the chanko party,
and she continued bringing smiles and satisfaction right up until curfew.

First comes the Make a Debut. Putting my spirit into it, I took a bite of the cookie,
and a gentle, warm flavor spread through my mouth.
Mmm~ Freshly picked really is buono~.

As Hishi Akebono spoke, sure enough, behind her were
other Umamusume happily devouring their chanko nabe.

You too, Trainer!
I made plenty, so eat as much as you like~.
...Oh, I guess so. You're right. But still!
Hishi Akebono's big, round eyes opened even wider.
Bono, you're super pumped today! All right, then so am I!
I'm not letting you catch up to me—!
Don't worry, I won't stop giving it my all☆
Haah, haah, haah...! Yay~!

Tracen Academy is just like a sumo stable, Trainer!
We all clash with each other and get stronger together!

Yeah, I always knew she was big, but...
Standing next to Biko Pegasus, she really is huge~!
Hishi Akebono stared straight ahead with sparkling, resolute eyes.
Ah, it's delicious... You used some rare vegetables in this, didn't you?

She wants to be there for her opponents. She wants to be an Umamusume
they can clash with at full power, and grow alongside them.

Hishi Akebono? Isn't she that tall girl?
She's always making super delicious food back at the dorms, right?

You say that, but you ran with plenty of guts out there.
Wanna join me for some stamina training sometime if you'd like?
Um... To the next... the next mountain over, I think?

Knowing her, she will surely become a big Umamusume
who brings smiles and satisfaction to everyone... She'll become "chanko nabe."

You bet! Bono's a great pal who always gives it her all against me!
...But man, I'm seriously frustrated about today!

Seemingly possessing limitless stamina, Hishi Akebono bustled briskly about.
Lured by the aroma, many Umamusume began trickling into the cafeteria.

The Umamusume who came for chanko nabe all left
looking thoroughly satisfied, exactly as Hishi Akebono had hoped.
What!?

After all, once you've clashed with everything you've got,
you've gotta share some buono food together~.

Bono-chan is amazing in races.
She's usually so gentle and easygoing, so it really surprised me.

I baked them with lots of love, so I'm sure they're super buono~♪
Here, say ahh☆
What Hishi Akebono envisions is both big and warm.

Because after a race, I really want everyone
to eat the absolute most delicious chanko nabe ever.

Actually, we're having a chanko nabe party after this~!
You're welcome to come eat too, Trainer☆

Ehehe. I've decided to always take races seriously~. Doing it
half-heartedly just isn't satisfying. Right, Biko-chan?♪

Phew~. Did everybody get some~?
All right then, time for me to dig in too!
...Fufu♪ I'm so glad everyone's having fun~.

So good!
I could eat bowls and bowls of this!

Enjoying dinner together with everyone having fun
reminds me of home! It is so very delicious!

Aaargh! That was so close today~!
Losing at the very end stings the most!

Despite spending last night outdoors, Hishi Akebono tore down the track
with a power that showed no sign of fatigue.

Come to think of it, Suzuka, you've been working really hard on your morning practice lately!
How far do you run?

Ah! Trainer! You could've rested, but
you came to watch~ Thank you!

Ehehe, that's right~.
I'd been gathering ingredients for today all along, after all~.

—Oh, right!
To thank you for keeping me company yesterday, I baked cookies~!
Just then, the wild vegetables she put in her mouth looked familiar. They were the same ones gathered in the mountains yesterday. I thought they were all lost in the river, but—
Haah, haah, haah!

First across the line is Hishi Akebono! First is Hishi Akebono!
She clinches victory by a narrow margin!

Here they come into the final straightaway! Hishi Akebono in the lead,
Biko Pegasus closing in—will she catch up, or will Akebono hold on!?

Trainer, Trainer, what's wrong~?
You look a bit spaced out?

Eat up, everyone~!
It's super-duper buono☆
